params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

params.name: numColumns
params.description: Number of columns to lock, starting from the first column on the left.

overloads.semanticRole: Locks the first numColumns columns of the designated list box so they no longer scroll with the rest of the columns.
